title: MemeLens: Multilingual Multitask VLMs for Memes
base_benchmarks: MIMIC: Multimodal islamophobic meme identification and classification
findings: The paper includes a dataset for detecting Islamophobic memes (MIMIC). The proposed unified multitask model, MEMELENS, achieved the highest performance on this task (70.7% accuracy) compared to unimodal baselines and other multimodal approaches, demonstrating the effectiveness of the unified training approach for this specific type of harmful content detection.
